label: PagerRTTY to TAK
info:
Receives decoded PagerRTTY lines over UDP from the PagerRTTY receiver (minimodem) and sends CoT to TAK Server.
Positions -> a-f-G-U-C marker. SALUTE / SITREP / MSG -> GeoChat (All Chat Rooms).
Checksum-validated; repeats within 120 s are dropped.

name: Setup: set the TAK host and cert in the TLS node, UDP port must match NR_PORT on the receiver
info:
1. Open the 'PagerRTTY cert' TLS config: set the client cert + key (one cert for this feed).
2. Open 'TAK Server (PagerRTTY)': set your TAK Server host (port 8089).
3. Receiver: /etc/default/pagerrtty-rx NR_HOST = this Node-RED, NR_PORT = 4545.
4. Deploy. Send 'Test tones' from the Pager.
